clockwork-puzzle.note: user-supplied, made by the user for Turing (the game score); the user's own track
clockwork-puzzle.command: ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -y -i '<source>' -map 0:a:0 -af volume=-4.8dB -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 48000 -ac 2 -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact -movflags +faststart -f ipod music/clockwork-puzzle.m4a
